messages:
Samir Patel (Sales): FYI handing off Veridian / VertaLabs. Signed last week, 6-seat Dedicated plan with Private deployment requested. Main asks: SSO + SCIM, on-prem connector proof-of-concept, and stronger SLA. Renewal conversation due in 10 months — flagged moderate risk: legal needs SOC2 evidence and slow procurement timeline.
Lina Gomez (CS): Thanks Samir — adding context. Current onboarding status: provisioning scheduled for 3/29, API keys staged, initial prompt templates pending. Customer wants an enablement session for their ML infra team week of 4/5.
Samir Patel (Sales): Confirmed they prefer Tues 4/6 afternoon PT. Also noted they only used trial credits ~20% — they want cost certainty before more consumption.
Rachel Ortiz (Acct Exec): they asked about potential burst capacity during training runs — we promised to scope Dedicated burst options.
Onboarding Bot: Provisioning: private deploy env creation started (step 1/4). Ticket #ONB-483 created.
Igor Petrov (Support): Heads-up — SSO requires Okta SAML + SCIM mapping. We'll likely need a short engineering task to expose metadata endpoints for their provisioning tool. ETA for connector template: 5 business days after we get their Okta metadata.
Emily Chen (Solutions): I can run a 45min arch-ops session for their infra team. Will cover KV cache sizing, batching, and cost/latency tradeoffs. Need their sequence length and concurrency targets beforehand.
Lina Gomez (CS): Action items: 1) @Igor open ENG ticket for metadata endpoint + nginx reverse proxy guidance — owner Igor — due 2026-04-02. 2) @Emily prepare enablement slide deck + runbook — owner Emily — due 2026-04-03. 3) @Samir share customer Okta metadata and primary contact (name+email) — owner Samir — due 2026-03-25. 4) @Rachel scope burst pool options with pricing (draft) — owner Rachel — due 2026-03-28. 5) CS to schedule enablement session for 2026-04-06 2pm PT — owner Lina — due 2026-03-26.
Igor Petrov (Support): I'll create ENG-715 (SSO connector) and link ONB-483. If they need on-prem install, we may require a site-visit checklist for network/firewall rules.
Lina Gomez (CS): Renewal risk note: legal has flagged SOC2 Type II as a gating item for procurement. @Samir can you confirm whether Veridian accepts SOC2 attestation only or needs code-level audit? Also capture procurement timeline so we can escalate.
Samir Patel (Sales): They accepted attestation for now but legal asked about data residency guarantees — I'll ask and report back today.
Emily Chen (Solutions): For the enablement, ask them to send a short perf target matrix: tokens/sec per user, p95 latency target, and nightly batch sizes. That helps me recommend quantization and batching profiles.
Lina Gomez (CS): Capture feedback loop: we'll run a post-enable survey (3 q's) and add to their account in Gainsight. Also tagging account with risk: "contract: SOC2-pending" and "onboarding: private-deploy".
Rachel Ortiz (Acct Exec): I'll draft the burst pricing options and include a short note on how burst affects SLA.
Samir Patel (Sales): Sharing Okta contact: michael.huang@vertalabs.com. He'll send metadata today.
Onboarding Bot: Reminder: scheduled enablement session created - 2026-04-06 14:00 PT. Calendar invites pending acceptance.
Lina Gomez (CS): Next check-in: 2026-03-26 to confirm all owners have started tasks. If SOC2 still pending by 2026-04-10, we escalate to legal lead (marcus.legal@redwood.ai).
Igor Petrov (Support): Noted. Will post ENG-715 link here when created.
Emily Chen (Solutions): I'll prepare the slide deck and quick-run checklist; will also include a cost/run example for 100k tokens/day.
Lina Gomez (CS): Thanks team — filing this thread into the account playbook. Short-term owners: Igor / Emily / Samir / Rachel. I'll follow up Monday with a readiness checklist. :thumbsup:
